subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “City Hall added a chatbot to answer common questions about trash pickup, parking rules, and public services.”?
options: It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.
The project improved safety, but it also taught humility.
The counselor read the notes and planned class talks based on common problems.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The project improved safety, but it also taught humility.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The counselor read the notes and planned class talks based on common problems.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Signs were also improved.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.」，答案為「It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
